disclaimer: Platform-informed screening simulation based on public Workday documentation. The Job Application business process is tenant-configured; no Workday ranking is reproduced.

scenarios.title: Standard Review subprocess
scenarios.description: Application enters Review; an authorised reviewer inspects resume and cover letter and selects Move Forward or Decline.

scenarios.title: Screen or Assessment subprocess
scenarios.description: Configured subprocesses filter against basic criteria or gather assessment results before a human decision.

scenarios.title: Configured questionnaire evaluation
scenarios.description: Questionnaire answers and scores can feed condition rules that automatically route, advance or decline.

scenarios.title: Optional AI-supported prioritisation
scenarios.description: Candidate Skills Match or separately purchased HiredScore may prioritise or grade applicants with explanations; humans decide.
emphasis: explicit skills and qualifications in text
